full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah, J. This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated the 22nd day of November, 2009 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 883 of 2006 making the Rule absolute. Facts necessary for disposal of this petition are that petitioner as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 44 of 1996 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 5th Court, Gazipur for declaration that the Kabala being No. 2577 dated 07.02.1970 in favour of defendant No. 1 was illegal, collusive, fraudulent, forged, without any consideration and not binding and for recovery of khas possession as well. 

 12. From the judgment and decree of the trial Court. It appears that it did not at all come to any finding as to when the plaintiff had been put into the possession of the suit land and on which date he was dispossessed, one of the relief's prayed for in the suit being for recovery of khas possession such finding was a must. The trial Court in a negative way found possession of the plaintiffs vendor and the plaintiff without coming to any finding in that respect with reference to the evidence on record. We consider it better to quote the finding of the trial Court which is as under: 

 14. Another important legal aspect of the case is that in the plaint the plaintiff himself admitted that because of the kabala being No. 2577 dated 07.02.1970, his title in the suit land was clouded; it was incumbent upon him to pray for declaration of title in the suit but he did not; so the suit for recovery of khas possession without the prayer for declaration of title was not maintainable.
